dimension_assessments.summary: The export derives forall t, a.s. a_t>=-w*lower/r from a finite nonnegative limit of R^(-T)*a_(T+1), with r>0 and the assigned adapted feasibility premises.

Shifted NP01 and geometric convergence give the coarse floor. Uniform-gap extraction and finite-block independence produce a feasible violating path. The debt recursion drives its assets below that coarse floor; wage scaling and date indices agree.
Assets are real original/net assets measurable from draws before t. Consumption and a_(t+1) may respond to labor_t. The budget is c_t+a_(t+1)=(1+r)*a_t+w*labor_t, and naturalLimit is w*lower/r.

Rendered A93 extraction p.1, printed 37/original PDF 38, contains Proposition 1's converse. A94 extraction p.1, printed 666/original PDF 9, note 16 supports the relationship. The ledger correctly labels detailed measure and recursion proofs as reconstructions.
Actual premises are compact probability support, NONDEGENERATE, r,w>0, measurable prefixes, a.s. budgets, c>=0 and the finite nonnegative limit. Helper gaps, widths and horizons are derived.

The plan structure imposes no asset floor. The coarse floor and positive block probability are proved. Premises are nonvacuous: a_t=0 and c_t=w*labor_t give a feasible adapted plan with terminal limit zero.
NP03 uses NP01's telescope core; no M10A3 helper imports or applies NP02. The shared wrapper adds only the authorized import and NP03 theorem. Certified NP01/NP02 fingerprints are unchanged.

Real assets and arbitrary compact labor probability laws remain general. Infinite IID products and positive lower-neighborhood mass support the proof without density, endpoint atoms or finite-support restrictions.

NP03 uses budget and debt arguments only; no rightMarginalValue or zero-boundary marginal occurs. The mandatory distinction between positive-state rightMarginalValue and economic zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal is preserved.

The geometric series is proved summable before its real sum enters the limit comparison. Joint-event probabilities are multiplied directly in ENNReal. There is no ENNReal-to-Real conversion or unsupported expectation/integrability step.

Convergence is a real sequence limit along almost every path. Shifting dates multiplies its finite limit by R^t. No weak, total-variation, L1 or moment convergence is inferred, and predecessor convergence restrictions remain intact.
Consumption need only be nonnegative. No beta, beta*R<1, positive consumption, utility smoothness, optimality, NATURAL_CAP or zero terminal limit enters the public theorem or its helpers.
Inspected new proofs contain no sorry, admit, project axiom, native_decide or unsafe bypass. Controller prohibited-pattern and no-sorry checks pass; every new export is explicitly audited.
All 19 new-export transitive axiom inventories contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The controller's 707-declaration audit reports the same permitted union.
All 19 export names match signature and axiom inventories. Both audit files contain #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms for each. The public elaborated signature matches the inspected wrapper.

Ledger signature, assumptions, finite-block proof and REVIEW_READY status match Lean. Global status preserves predecessors and leaves E01–E03 unformalized. Controller documentation synchronization passes.

The proof formalizes the economic inability to finance excess debt: predetermined debt remains exposed to a finite low-income block of positive probability, whose budget consequences contradict even the maximum-income repayment bound.

The probability law is an actual infinite product. Datewise a.s. feasibility is intersected before choosing a path. The export preserves the natural floor and finite nonnegative limit without assuming zero or foresight.
New declarations construct NP03's path interface, finite-block probability and debt contradiction only. No helper proves E01–E03 or later economics; the Stage10a human checkpoint remains reserved.

The inspected argument, source correspondence, exact export audits and preservation evidence jointly justify NP03 adequacy. No blocker remains; promotion and the operative verdict belong to the controller.
